title: White space and nibbles in bytes.fromhex
summary: Each output byte requires a pair of hexadecimal digits; starting with Python 3.7, all ASCII whitespace is skipped between bytes.
applies: Python 3; standard library or built-in integers
detail: 41 followed by a newline and then 42 solves AB; only the end of a digit cannot form a new byte.
boundary: Delimiter colons, 0x prefixes, and spaces between nibbles are not considered interbyte spaces.
relevance: Distinguish between delimiters and real data in hex export text.
